decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher sits close to the core postpress portfolio and has its own page, so it supports established customer needs at low cost and does not trigger problemistic search.

Although UV spot varnishing is distant from the core, it was launched as a flagship with a German premiere event in 2023, so its results are still uncertain and slack in a broad portfolio allows the firm to carry it toward its enhancement strategy.
The sheet preparation module builds on existing systems and complements multifinisher sales, so performance is likely judged acceptable against modest aspirations.
The B2 multifinisher is a core-adjacent flagship featured on the home page, which signals strong commitment and fit with the automation direction.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the established booklet-making offer and has its own page, so it fits the core business with little reason to drop it.
The folding add-on gets only a minor mention on the website, which makes it the most likely candidate for pruning, but as a low-cost accessory close to the core it will probably be retained.
